query:
SELECT r.id FROM roles r
         WHERE r.org_id = $1
           AND r.id IN (SELECT a.role_id FROM role_assignments a
                        WHERE a.org_id = $1 AND a.user_id = $2
                        UNION
                        SELECT e.role_id FROM enrollments e
                        WHERE e.org_id = $1 AND e.user_id = $2)
         ORDER BY r.id
         FOR KEY SHARE
